Kullback-Leibler divergence (DKL​)

Words: 45 Articles: 1
Probability and statistics OurBigBook.com
For probability densities p and q, the Kullback-Leibler divergence from q to p is
DKL​(p∥q)=Ep​[logq(X)p(X)​].
